description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart e-commerce system, handling customer-related data and actions such as login, logout, and retrieving customer info.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer in the Opencart system, managing customer data, authentication, and profile information.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using email and password, optionally overriding security checks, and initializes session data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current customer, clearing session data and resetting internal properties.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if the customer is currently logged in based on the customer_id property.

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is subscribed to the newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer has commenter status.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total customer balance.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total reward points for the customer.
